  1. 01TokenA chunk of text the model reads or writes. Not always a whole word.4 min

  23. 23Coding agentAn agent whose tools read and edit a repository and may run commands you allowed.4 min
  24. 24AllowlistThe tools or commands that may run. Everything else is denied.8 min
  25. 25LogitA score over the vocabulary before softmax. Temperature divides logits in the sampler, not inside attention.4 min
  26. 26SoftmaxTurns scores into a distribution that sums to one. The scale in attention is there so softmax does not saturate.4 min

  255. 255Purpose limitationGDPR Article 5(1)(b): a recording notice is not a training purpose.8 min
  256. 256Data minimisationGDPR Article 5(1)(c): adequate, relevant, and limited to the purpose.8 min
  257. 257PCI DSSPCI SSC’s page: a baseline for entities that store, process, or transmit cardholder or sensitive authentication data.4 min
  258. 258QSAA Qualified Security Assessor. This lab does not assign PCI scope.8 min
  259. 259Cardholder dataWhat PCI DSS is written to protect. A full card number stays out of the model, the log, and the pane.4 min
  260. 260Zero Data RetentionAn OpenAI approval, not the default. The fetched default abuse-monitoring window is up to 30 days.4 min
  261. 261Abuse monitoringOpenAI logs that can contain API prompts and responses, retained up to 30 days by default on the page fetched 2026-10-14.4 min
  262. 262CCPA deletionThe California Attorney General’s page: respond in 45 calendar days, extendable by another 45. A response window, not a retention period.4 min
  263. 263Consent eventA record that the stated purpose was played. If barge-in cut it off, the event is interrupted, not granted.4 min
  264. 264PANA primary account number. It does not belong in a prompt, a trace, or a fixture.4 min
  265. 265SinkOne place a fact is stored: recording, transcript, case, trace, provider log, or eval copy.4 min
  266. 266Non-parametric memoryThe 2020 RAG paper’s name for an index you can replace when facts change, beside the parametric generator.4 min
  267. 267RAG-SequenceLewis et al. marginalize retrieved documents once per output sequence. A historical training recipe, not a 2026 API flag.4 min
  268. 268RAG-TokenThe same paper’s per-token marginalization over retrieved documents. Do not cite it as a contact-center latency number.4 min
  269. 269Bi-encoderThe RAG paper initializes its retriever from Dense Passage Retrieval, a bi-encoder. Query and document are embedded separately.4 min
  270. 270Retrieve-then-readWhat teams usually mean by RAG now: a frozen chat model, an embeddings API, a vector index, and an abstain instruction.4 min
  271. 271Vector_cosine_opsThe pgvector operator class for an HNSW index on cosine distance. Cosine similarity is one minus the <=> distance.4 min
  272. 272DimensionsAn embeddings API parameter, on text-embedding-3 and later, that shortens a vector. Query and document widths still have to match.4 min
  273. 273Ef_searchThe HNSW query-time candidate list. The pgvector README’s filtering section mentions a default of 40 and an example of 100.4 min
  274. 274Ef_constructionThe HNSW build-time candidate list. The README example this room cites is 64, beside m = 16. It is an example, not a tuned index.4 min
  275. 275ProbesHow many IVFFlat lists a query searches. The README says to start near sqrt(lists). probes equal to lists is exact and may skip the index.4 min
  276. 276Iterative scanpgvector’s way, since 0.8.0, to keep looking when a filter is applied after an approximate index scan.4 min
  277. 277Rank_constantElasticsearch’s RRF retriever defaults this to 60, and it must be at least 1. The pgvector README does not lock the constant.4 min
  278. 278Rank_window_sizeOn the Elasticsearch 8.19 RRF guide, this defaults to 10 and must be at least the size you requested.4 min
  279. 279Cross-encoderA reranker that scores a query against a short candidate list. The pgvector README names it as an alternative to RRF, not a synonym.4 min
  280. 280K1Elasticsearch’s BM25 term-frequency saturation. The 8.19 similarity page defaults it to 1.2. This lab does not paste that default onto tsvector.4 min
  281. 281Discount_overlapsAn Elasticsearch BM25 switch, default true on the 8.19 page. It is not a pgvector setting.4 min
  282. 282Partial indexA Postgres index limited by a predicate, such as tenant and product, so a filter does not depend on post-scan leftovers.4 min
  283. 283Text-embedding-3-smallAn OpenAI embedding model whose guide default width is 1536. Do not mix it in one column with a 3072-width model.4 min
  284. 284Text-embedding-3-largeAn OpenAI embedding model whose guide default width is 3072. Same-model rule as the small model: one id per index.4 min
  285. 285Strict_orderAn HNSW iterative-scan mode the pgvector README names. This room records the name. It does not invent a second definition.4 min
  286. 286Relaxed_orderAn iterative-scan mode the pgvector README names for HNSW and for IVFFlat. Write down which mode the migration set.4 min
  287. 287Maintenance_work_memThe Postgres setting the pgvector README associates with an HNSW build notice past 100000 tuples. Raise it when that notice appears.4 min
  288. 288Lost in the middleLiu et al., arXiv:2307.03172. A historical finding that relevant text in the middle of a long context is easier to miss. Measure it. Do not quote their tables as an SLA.4 min
  289. 289Tool_useAnthropic’s block and stop_reason when the model wants a client tool. Your process executes after that stop. The model does not.4 min
  290. 290Stop_reasonWhy the model paused. tool_use means a client tool is waiting. It is not permission to skip the host.4 min
  291. 291Client toolA tool you execute after the model requests it. Anthropic’s docs split these from server tools the vendor executes.4 min
  292. 292Server toolA tool Anthropic executes, as opposed to a client tool your application executes. The split is in their tool-use docs.4 min
  293. 293Five-step tool loopOpenAI’s function-calling guide: send tools, receive a call, execute in your application, send the output back, receive another call or a final answer.4 min
  294. 294ALFWorldOne of the environments in the ReAct paper. The reported gain is a paper result, not a contact-center containment rate.4 min
  295. 295WebShopThe other ReAct environment cited beside ALFWorld. Same rule: quote the paper’s task, not your bot’s SLA.4 min
  296. 296HTTP+SSEThe MCP transport that revision 2024-11-05 used. Revision 2025-11-25 replaces it with Streamable HTTP.8 min
  297. 297MCP-Protocol-VersionThe header a Streamable HTTP client sends on later requests. The spec’s example is 2025-11-25. A missing header falls back to assuming 2025-03-26.4 min
  298. 298JSON Schema 2020-12The dialect MCP revision 2025-11-25 requires for tool input schemas that do not name another dialect.4 min
  299. 299SEP-1577Changelog line for revision 2025-11-25: add tool calling support to sampling via tools and toolChoice. The line does not say the model executes the tool.4 min
  300. 300Screen-popA side effect, like a transfer or a refund. A human or a tested function owns it. The model requesting it is not the execution.4 min
  301. 301Deterministic edgeA fixed graph branch, such as sending an over-cap amount to a human. A third model is another sample, not that control.4 min
  302. 302Conversable agentWu et al. describe agents as conversable and customizable, able to combine models, tools, and humans. Historical paper, not a host policy.4 min
  303. 303Untrusted tool descriptionMCP’s security principle: descriptions and annotations are untrusted unless the server is trusted. A description that says “safe” is not consent.4 min
  304. 304Shadow releaseThe first rollout step in the voice-agent room: a prompt hash, model id, tool list, and index build run where callers do not hear it yet.4 min
  305. 305Named queueThe second rollout step after shadow: one queue you can name and turn off. The dial-plan id is in the tenant routing config and varies by site.4 min
  306. 306Injection caseA golden case whose retrieved text tries to change the instruction. NIST Measure is running it before deployment, not after the incident.4 min
  307. 307Abstain caseA golden case where the pack lacks the fact and the graded outcome is refusal. A peaked logprob is not a pass.4 min
  308. 308Semantic conventionsThe OpenTelemetry GenAI repository this lab pins at commit 4e8a281 (2026-10-13). gen_ai.operation.name there is marked Development.4 min
  309. 309Embeddings operationOne value of gen_ai.operation.name on the pinned GenAI conventions tree, beside chat, execute_tool, and retrieval.4 min
  310. 310Unbounded consumptionOWASP LLM10: tokens, loops, and retries without a ceiling you set. A 429 from the vendor is late. The step budget should have stopped first.4 min
  311. 311Pre-deployment testNIST Measure, as the core excerpt states it: test before deployment and regularly in operation. A demo is not that test.4 min
  312. 312Virtual agentThe bot the caller hears. T7-R02 separates it from the assist pane a human sees. They are not one product because a catalog bundles them.4 min
  313. 313Scripted agentA Webex AI Agent Studio task type named on the help page fetched 2026-10-14, beside autonomous agents.4 min
  314. 314Autonomous agentThe other Webex AI Agent Studio task type on that page. Dynamics also uses the phrase for agents that converse and then hand off with history.4 min
  315. 315AI Agent StudioCisco’s Webex surface for integrating AI agents with voice and digital channels for Enterprise, Unified CCE, and Express.4 min
  316. 316Amazon Q in ConnectAmazon’s generative assistant in Connect, documented as built on Bedrock and as an evolution of Amazon Connect Wisdom.4 min
  317. 317Amazon Connect WisdomThe earlier Connect assistant that Amazon’s docs say Q in Connect evolves. Name the page you read. Do not merge the two products in a sentence.4 min
  318. 318Agent AnswersA Google CCAI feature the Webex integration article covers. That article says Agent Answers is not applicable to the Webex Contact Center solution.4 min
  319. 319Copilot Service workspaceThe Dynamics workspace where the help-pane article says representatives can answer questions, compose emails, and draft chat responses.4 min
  320. 320Turn-takingWho has the floor on a voice call. OpenAI’s Realtime getting-started guide names barge-in and turn-taking as aims of a speech-to-speech session.4 min
  321. 321Prefix_padding_msA server_vad example field. The VAD guide’s sample sets it to 300. That sample is not a millisecond SLA for your queues.4 min
  322. 322Silence_duration_msA server_vad example field. The same sample sets it to 500. Do not promote the sample into a queue target.4 min
  323. 323Partial transcriptText from speech recognition before the caller has finished. This lab does not execute a tool on it.4 min
  324. 324Interrupt_responseA server_vad example flag, true in the fetched sample, meaning a detected interruption can cancel the model’s response.4 min
  325. 325Google CCAIContact Center AI. A Webex article says Webex CCE, Unified CCE, and Packaged CCE support a Google CCAI connector.4 min
  326. 326Webex ConnectThe digital-channel path the Webex AI agent article names for WhatsApp, SMS, email, Facebook Messenger, Apple Messages for Business, and live chat.4 min
  327. 327Unified CCECisco Unified Contact Center Enterprise. The Webex AI agent article lists it as a platform the studio can integrate with.4 min
  328. 328Dynamics 365 Contact CenterMicrosoft’s contact-center product, embedded and standalone, on the Learn pages fetched 2026-10-14. Those pages are not a walk of the lab tenant.4 min
  329. 329Real-time assistanceWhat Amazon’s Connect admin guide says Customer AI agents can do for a human inside the agent workspace: intent, generative responses, links, and actions.4 min
  330. 330Self-service agentA Customer AI agent the caller talks to on voice or chat, as Connect’s admin guide describes it, separate from assistance shown to a human.4 min
  331. 331System prompt leakageOWASP LLM07. The hidden instruction is disclosed, including any secret you mistakenly put there. The prompt is not a vault.4 min
  332. 332Excessive agencyOWASP LLM06. The system can call tools that do too much, too often, or without a person. Two agents do not double the permission.4 min
  333. 333Sensitive information disclosureOWASP LLM02. A card number in a prompt, a transcript, or a trace is this failure.4 min
  334. 334Improper output handlingOWASP LLM05. Downstream code trusts model text. A valid JSON amount is still checked by the tool.4 min
  335. 335Data movementThe Copilot help-pane article says that outside North America, Bing-powered search needs data movement across regions enabled in the Power Platform admin center.4 min
  336. 336Cross-cuttingHow the AI RMF core excerpt describes Govern: it crosses Map, Measure, and Manage. The functions are not a checklist you reorder at will.4 min
  337. 337Incident responsePart of Manage in the AI RMF core excerpt: allocate resources to respond, recover, and communicate. A function with no person is a heading.4 min
  338. 338Create_responseA server_vad example flag, true in the fetched VAD sample, meaning the server may start a response when it detects the end of speech.4 min
  339. 339Virtual Agent voiceThe CCAI voice product named in the Webex integration article beside Agent Answers. Read that article before you say which product applies to Webex Contact Center.4 min
  340. 340Conversation historyWhat the Dynamics overview says an autonomous agent hands to a representative. The handoff is context, not a second authority to post a refund.4 min
  341. 341Apple Messages for BusinessOne digital channel the Webex AI agent article lists through Webex Connect, beside WhatsApp, SMS, email, Messenger, and live chat.4 min
  342. 342Packaged CCEA Cisco platform the Webex connector article says can use a Google CCAI connector, beside Webex CCE and Unified CCE.4 min
  343. 343Contact Center ExpressCisco Contact Center Express. The Webex AI Agent Studio article lists it with Enterprise and Unified CCE.4 min
  344. 344Power Platform admin centerWhere the Copilot help-pane article says cross-region data movement is enabled for Bing-powered search outside North America.4 min
  345. 345Bing-powered searchThe web search the Dynamics help-pane article ties to a data-movement control. It is not a license to log raw audio.4 min
  346. 346Post-contact summaryConnect’s name for a structured recap. Agents see voice and email on the CCP. Managers see voice, chat, and email on the admin site.4 min
  347. 347After-contact workThe wrap-up time Connect’s summary page says agents use post-contact summaries to finish, on voice and email.4 min
  348. 348Wrap-up summaryThe Webex draft an agent gets after clicking Wrap Up: call reason, actions, resolution, and follow-ups. The agent reviews it before complete.4 min
  349. 349Wrap-up codeA code from the administrator’s list. If Webex auto-wrap-up and its timer are on, the article says the AI-suggested code is what gets stored.4 min
  350. 350Dropped-call summaryA Webex recap of a call that dropped. The article says processing can take up to 60 seconds, and a return call inside that window may not have it.4 min
  351. 351AI Quality ManagementWebex’s supervisor tools for evaluations, sentiment, coaching insights, a performance dashboard, and Analyzer reports. The fetched article says English only, for now.4 min
  352. 352Intraday forecastConnect updates this every 15 minutes, only for a queue-channel with at least 5000 unique contacts per week over the last 4 weeks.4 min
  353. 353Short-term forecastConnect’s daily forecast for scheduling up to 18 weeks ahead. It predicts contact volume and average handle time from historical metrics.4 min
  354. 354Quality evaluationDynamics’ supervisor-defined scoring of cases and conversations. The article says it is not for employment decisions such as pay or seniority.4 min
  355. 355Session segmentGoogle’s split of a session when more than one human handled it. On chat, a segment is also created on transfer to a human or a virtual agent.4 min
  356. 356Average handle timeOne of the two things Connect’s forecast tries to predict, beside contact volume. Webex’s QM dashboard can also display it. A dashboard is not a schedule.4 min
  357. 357Sentiment analysisWebex AI QM scores customer sentiment from transcripts. It can flag a contact for a supervisor. It does not staff the queue.4 min
